Agent Name: Assistant
Step Number: 22
Reason for Mistake: The Assistant incorrectly calculated the total cost of daily tickets by using only 3 family members (2 adults + 1 child) instead of the full family of 4 (2 adults + 1 child age 5 + 1 child age 2). This data misuse led to an underestimation of the daily ticket cost ($99 instead of $132), which directly caused the erroneous conclusion that annual passes result in a loss of $201 rather than a savings of $129.
